files.text: --- title: "Add images and video clips" sidebarTitle: "Images and video" description: "Put a picture or a clip into a HyperFrames video, then place, trim, crop or swap it: ask the agent, drag it in, or write two attributes." --- import { DocsVideo } from "/snippets/docs-video.jsx"; Put a picture or a clip into your video three ways: ask the agent, drag it into the editor, or write it in the HTML. All three change the same file, so you can mix them. *Import, place, crop, trim, then swap the file: the crop, timing and placement stay as they were.* ## Ask the agent Name the file and say what should happen, in terms of what you see: ```text Use assets/product-tour.mp4 from 00:04 to 00:10, muted. Crop around the editor canvas and place it under the captions. ``` The agent copies the file into the project if it isn't there yet. In the Studio app, add the file to your message with **+** or drop it into the chat. ## Drag it in In the browser editor (`npx hyperframes preview`), open **Assets**, choose **Import media** or drop the file into the panel, then drag it onto the timeline. Images, SVG, MP4, WebM and MOV work.
